title: 第7章 胡同的厕所要排队
content_zh:
起床后，刘济民走到院子里呼吸几口新鲜空气。大杂院里，水龙头前排起了长队，铁盆和牙刷牙盒咚咚锵锵，撞击声不断，一个个冻得缩着脖子，吸溜个不停。

    除此之外，每家派出一个代表，端着尿盆或者提着尿桶往外走。大家也不觉得尴尬，甚至上了年纪的一边闻着尿骚味，还聊着今天早上要吃什么。

    刘济民看到这一幕，赶紧闭上了嘴巴，匆匆洗把脸就准备回校。

    “去，先帮我把尿盆倒了去！”王爱梅说道。

    刘济民连忙说道：“妈，我再不回学校，可要挨处分了！”

    说完抱起冰凉的自行车撒丫子就跑，狭窄的夹道内残留着骚味儿。胡同内大家共用一个厕所，厕所外面排起了长队。一群人手里端着尿盆，一脸焦急地望着厕所口，双脚情不自禁地往前挤，跟踏步似的。

    “哎呦喂，这怎么还不出来，都多久了。”抱怨声此起彼伏。

    “嘿！李春燕，你这踏步挺标准的！”刘济民路过女厕时，看到李春燕忍不住调侃道。

    李春燕骂道：“小仔！有本事你下来，本姑娘请你吃早点！”

    刘济民哈哈大笑，只留给李春燕一个摆手的背影。

    到了胡同口的早餐店，刘济民要了一根油条垫垫肚子，等到了学校再吃点。

    大学对工农兵大学生一直实行的是半军事化管理，早上六点半要跑操，并进行简单的队列训练。随着77级高考大学生陆续入校，学校对于工农兵大学生的管理也在改变，并没有以往那么严格了。

    2月底，77级高考生正式入学，这也是国家第一次春季入学的大学生。

    医学科学院在东城区东单三条9号，紧挨着王府井，骑自行车不到二十分钟。

    中国医学科学院和协和医学院属于院校一体单位，两家在一个地方。

    九号院正门的建筑风格古朴典雅，红柱绿瓦，雕梁画栋。穿过正门，很快就来到了宿舍区。

    学校的广播正在播放《交城的山》，学校很小，在门口就能听到操场上传来的口号声。
content_en:
After getting up, Liu Jimin walked to the yard to take a few breaths of fresh air. In the courtyard, there was a long queue in front of the faucet. The iron basin and the toothbrush box were clanging and banging, and everyone was so cold that they were shrinking their necks and sucking.

    In addition, each family sends a representative to go out carrying a urinal or a urinal bucket. No one felt embarrassed, even the elderly ones were chatting about what they were going to eat this morning while smelling urine.

    When Liu Jimin saw this scene, he quickly shut his mouth, washed his face in a hurry, and prepared to go back to school.

    "Go, help me empty the urinal first!" Wang Aimei said.

    Liu Jimin quickly said: "Mom, if I don't go back to school, I will be punished!"

    After saying that, he picked up the cold bicycle and ran away, leaving a filthy smell in the narrow road. Everyone in the alley shared a toilet, and there was a long queue outside the toilet. A group of people were holding urinals in their hands, looking anxiously at the toilet entrance, and their feet couldn't help but push forward, as if they were stepping.

    "Hey, why hasn't this come out yet? How long has it been?" Complaints kept coming.

    "Hey! Li Chunyan, your steps are quite standard!" Liu Jimin couldn't help teasing when he saw Li Chunyan while passing by the women's toilet.

    Li Chunyan scolded: "Little boy! If you can, come down and I'll treat you to breakfast!"

    Liu Jimin laughed loudly, leaving Li Chunyan with only a wave from behind.

    When he arrived at the breakfast shop at the entrance of the alley, Liu Jimin ordered a fried dough stick to cushion his stomach, and would eat some when he got to school.

    The university has always implemented semi-military management for worker, peasant and soldier college students. They have to run exercises and conduct simple queue training at 6:30 in the morning. As the 77-level college entrance examination students gradually enter the school, the school's management of worker, peasant and soldier college students is also changing, and it is not as strict as before.

    At the end of February, the 77-level college entrance examination students were officially admitted. This was also the country’s first spring admission for college students.

    The Academy of Medical Sciences is located at No. 9, Dongdan Santiao, Dongcheng District, next to Wangfujing, less than 20 minutes by bicycle.

    The Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Union Medical College are integrated institutions, and they are located in the same place.

    The architectural style of the main entrance of No. 9 Courtyard is simple and elegant, with red pillars, green tiles, carved beams and painted buildings. Passing through the main entrance, we soon arrived at the dormitory area.

    The school radio is playing "Jiaocheng Mountains". The school is very small, and you can hear slogans coming from the playground at the door.
title_en: Chapter 7 There is a queue for the toilet in the alley
